apiKeyModal.title: Your Gemini key
apiKeyModal.description: SailTrim uses your own Gemini key. It's free (1,500 queries per day, no cost) and never leaves your browser: it's stored only on your device and sent exclusively to Google.
apiKeyModal.noKeyBanner: 🧭 Don't have a key? Get it in 5 steps
apiKeyModal.placeholder: Paste your API key here (starts with AIza… or AQ.…)
apiKeyModal.fullGuide: View full guide: how to get your free key

apiGuide.title: How to get your free key
apiGuide.subtitle: It's a 5-minute process you only do once. Follow these steps:

steps.title: Open Google AI Studio
steps.text: Click the blue button below. A Google page will open in another browser tab.

steps.title: Sign in with your Google account
steps.text: Use whichever Gmail you want. It's free: Google won't ask you to pay at any point.

steps.title: Create your key
steps.text: Click the «Create API key» button. Google will generate your key automatically.

steps.title: Copy it
steps.text: Click the copy icon next to the key. It doesn't matter if it starts with «AIza» or «AQ.» — both are valid.

steps.title: Paste it in SailTrim
steps.text: Close this help, go back to the «Set up key» box, paste your key and press «Save». You're now ready to analyze trim!

apiGuide.watchVideo: Prefer to watch a video? Watch tutorial
apiGuide.disclaimer: With your key, Google gives you 1,500 free queries per day. SailTrim only uses it inside your browser: we never send it to any of our own servers.
